Rohiṇī
------------------------------------------
Rohiṇī was the first wife of Vasudeva and the मोथेर् of बलराम, elder brother of कृष्ण. In their earlier life they were Surasā and कश्यप. They were reborn due to a curse of the god वरुण.
Rohiṇī was also the name of a cow—a daughter of कामधेनु, the celestial cow—who gave birth to all the cows of the world.
One of the twenty-seven daughters of दक्ष married to चन्द्र (Moon), रोहिणी was his dearest wife.
As a नक्षत्र or star-constellation (the 4th in the list of 27) रोहिणी comprises the स्तर्स् alpha, theta, gamma, delta and epsilon Tauri.
In Hindu अस्त्रोलोग्य्, it is an auspicious star suitable for the performance of चौल (first haircut for a male child), उपनयन (investiture with the sacred thread), विवाह (marriage) and so on.
